title: Staying in touch with music through the Amsterdam Club
summary: He cannot play but follows music.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Tell me now, what -- you just decided one day that you were not going to play anymore.

Well, listen, there's a lot of young musicians coming in. And, yeah, I used to follow the bands as much as I could to see them on the radio or read about them in the papers or books. And then the Amsterdam, you see, that's one organization where we keep in touch with everything that's going on.

So when I go up there with the fellows, I'm in my element there. We talk music, I can find out things. It was killing me that I couldn't work and couldn't play. But I never lost touch with music. Now, that night that we went down to the Biltmore Hotel, about two weeks later we (unintelligible) up at the Amsterdam, and we had __________ up there. And she
brought some friends with her, oh, we had a great time.
